receipt_record.semantics: Times are actual UTC clocks. New history is received when fetched and never backdated to bar dates. Raw bytes are immutable; corrections append a new source object and revision receipt.

recommendation.bootstrap: After stock-manifest approval, retrieve one 60-eligible-session adjusted daily window for each of 50 stocks plus SPY and 11 sector ETFs, one dated ticker-details response per stock, and globally date-bounded split pages filtered to all 62 symbols.
recommendation.path: A separate bounded pre-assembly Massive REST acquisition process preserves immutable raw responses and receipts on a single-writer Render persistent disk; the existing snapshot assembler reads that store cache-only.
recommendation.reason: No disk/root, 180-day backup policy, account plan/entitlement, approved stock universe, or effective-dated sector mapping is evidenced.
recommendation.recurring: On each pilot session, acquire the prior completed-session daily aggregate for 62 unique symbols plus newly available split pages; finish by 07:30 America/New_York, before 07:45 manifest binding.
recommendation.storage: Proposed /var/data/moneybot/alpha_atlas_v4/acquisition/v1 on a disk attached to the single collector service; append-only objects/receipts and a separately verified backup copy.

storage_budget.assumptions: Uncompressed ceilings; corrections, failed attempts, mappings and receipts count. Expected sizes are planning estimates, not live measurements. Backup is a second verified copy.
storage_budget.proposed_cap_scope: uncompressed primary plus one verified backup copy through 180 days
storage_budget.retention_note: 180 days is duration, not an additional copy per day; Render's documented disk snapshots are available at least seven days and do not alone prove 180-day backup retention.

universe.precise_missing_input: The repository contains no reviewed, static, outcome-independent <=50 common-stock universe source. Dynamic watchlists/decision logs are user- or observation-driven; examples are not authorization; provider listing enumeration has not been saved for this purpose.
universe.proposed_rule_after_input_exists: From one user-approved, effective-dated common-stock source snapshot, retain US common stocks already covered by the account, sort by permanent typed identifier then ticker, and take the first 50. Freeze before session one; do not filter on returns, scores, retrieval success, or later eligibility.
universe.top_five_limitation: Selecting both equals the eligible baseline and cannot test top-five stock selection.
